smelt_pytest.environment: isolated runtime + pytest dependencies from compatible cached wheels

skip_reasons: Interpreter-specific parser case not applicable to the running grammar
Windows account lacks symlink creation privilege

maximus.scope: Fixed audit-branch snapshot, source analysis plus the explicitly selected codegen suite; no live checkout edits

independent_codebase.analysis: static comparison only; pytest not executed
independent_codebase.review: Object attribute replacements and private testing-helper access are real syntax. Their use is often deliberate protocol/resource observation; neither a global mock ban nor public exposure of testing-helper internals is recommended. Six repeated public-method findings on one private class were removed by a portable regression.

confirmed_improvements: Three known mock interaction tests no longer receive missing-outcome warnings.
22 literal MonkeyPatch targets are recognized across the audited Maximus workspace and Hermes.
Five retained-controller private helper calls are recognized through a known fixture tuple without executing fixtures.
Fixed immutable/literal-range loops are preserved; mutable aliases and uncertain control flow remain conservative.
The original two codegen tests pass with empty generators; the corrected tests fail with AssertionError. Both shapes are covered by independent executable regression fixtures.
Configuration warnings survive every output format and participate in the warning failure threshold.

opt_in_review: Known deadlines and scheduler-clock replacement review
not_recommended_as_universal_gates: Exposing production internals solely to satisfy a warning
Cosmetic assert-None checks for successful validation
policy_decisions.deferred_reason: Separate architecture policy capabilities require their own examples and scope decisions; they are not prerequisites for this test-evidence iteration.

limits: Static analysis does not prove effectiveness, general reachability or persistence correctness.
Unknown factories, conflicting fixture outputs, arbitrary field types and external plugin fixture overrides remain uncertain.
A local timeout is not independent when its scheduler clock is frozen.
No full Maximus native, Linux or PostgreSQL suite, nor the Python 3.12/other-OS CI matrix, was executed in this iteration.
Comparison completion permits analysis findings; it does not mean either project inventory is clean.
reproduce: Use scripts/evaluate.py on a fixed source revision with two Smelt import roots and identical policy bytes. Candidate-only policies require a separate review run. See README evaluation workflow.
